chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Words of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic
And when they persist in what they have done, while they know
He said: Persistence is when he commits a sin, then does not seek forgiveness from Allah, nor does he discuss repentance with himself. That is persistence.

key_terms.إِصْرَارٌ: Persistence or steadfastness in continuing an action, specifically sin in this context
key_terms.يُحَدِّثَ نَفْسَهُ: To converse with oneself or reflect internally

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of persisting in sin according to Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) clarifies that 'persistence' (israr) in this context is defined by the internal spiritual state of neglecting self-reflection and forgiveness rather than merely the repetition of the act. This distinction highlights the Shia emphasis on the psychological and volitional aspects of sin, where the failure to actively seek repentance constitutes the true persistence. Such exegesis serves as a practical guide for believers to evaluate the depth of their spiritual connection after committing a fault.
